data.title: C059: consolidate reviewed development into main and reconcile branch history
data.body:
## Why this integration is needed

The current main contains the completed force release, while reach development and evidence have accumulated across 34 open draft PRs and 104 branches. This makes the current code and next product work difficult to identify. The owner explicitly authorized decisions, main integration and branch cleanup while preserving OntoKin's AI-agent 3D language mission.

## Selected behavior

This candidate preserves the C058 evidence stack and selects the reviewed C032 development runtime. The two held C035 runtime deltas are restored to their exact C032 blobs. C035's original 29-test module is preserved byte-for-byte under the reconciliation record, with a documentation-only pointer at the old path. Its held results remain unchanged.

Reach remains explicitly selected through source/profile0.6, Agent/0.6 and GLB/0.6. Existing capabilities/discovery strings now identify it as experimental and release-incomplete. Earlier defaults, contracts, fixtures, independent oracles, numerical tolerances and resource limits remain unchanged.

The PR records rejection of exact M1 for comparison-only operation saving and adopts OK-ENG-009: reviewed development increments may enter main without claiming the whole finite release. Checkpoints become commits on active scoped branches instead of another branch layer.

## History preservation

All104 original branch names and95 distinct heads are retained by archive/pre-consolidation-20261028 at e6917dae0be3a786c22e76be3de62e3c97784cf5. Independent readback verified its complete parent set and exact index blobs. That archive is historical retention only and must never be merged into main. Actual branch removals and superseded-PR dispositions will be recorded separately after per-ref checks.

## Validation and remaining gates

Actual candidate:4155acfd1b01e1b72aac23be5e28b054d2e10440; tree6afc9960c5551115c87aafdcbc1d9d002172d5f6. Complete local core/visual/Agent checks are running on the exact published candidate, followed by force native/browser preservation checks. No passing result is claimed yet. The full source snapshot and original commit/tree were recovered and hash-verified before edits.

Historical original28 remains24/28, failed, with P11/P16/P23/L03 unresolved. C035 remains held, including adverse timing. C057's comparison accounting/passive-authority concern and all R01–R12/Q01–Q22, compatibility, rate, delivery, native/browser/visual and formal input-closure obligations remain open. This is development integration, not reach release acceptance or live game-engine certification.

Ownership and bounded scope: https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/26#issuecomment-6478260243
Main lease and cleanup delegation: https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/26#issuecomment-6478492739

data.message:
archive: preserve all pre-consolidation branch histories

Historical retention only: all 104 original refs and 95 distinct heads are indexed. Parentage preserves Git history and does not accept or integrate any experiment. Never merge this index-only tree into main.
